official_statement_rationale: While headline CPI inflation has moderated from its peak, at 5.10 per cent it remains above our 4.00 per cent target. The persistence of food inflation at 8.30 per cent continues to pose risks to the disinflationary trajectory and could potentially unanchor inflation expectations. Given the robust GVA growth of 6.80 per cent and a positive output gap of 0.50 per cent, the economy exhibits resilience, allowing us the space to remain focused on price stability. A shift in the stance of withdrawal of accommodation would be premature at this juncture, as we need to ensure that inflation aligns durably with the target. Therefore, I vote to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 6.50 per cent and to continue with the stance of withdrawal of accommodation.
